title: AI Agent Registry record
description: One live AI agent session as tracked by the native local AI Agent Registry (spec section 19). Field set is exactly the spec section 19.2 example record. This is a machine-emitted JSON runtime record: snake_case field names, strict additionalProperties. Spec placeholders: '...' in the 19.2 example stands for an RFC 3339 timestamp; 'x.y.z' stands for an agent version string.

session_id.title: Agent session id
session_id.description: Unique identifier of this agent session, 'agt_' prefix (spec sections 19.2, 22). Also used for process attribution, e.g. cgroup path punar/agents/atlas/claude/agt_8927 (spec section 22).

agent.title: Agent name
agent.description: Name of the AI agent product running in this session, e.g. 'claude-code' (spec section 19.2). Lowercase kebab/dotted name; matches the 'name' of an agent-definition.json document for managed and observed agents.

version.title: Agent version
version.description: Version string of the agent binary for this session (spec section 19.2 shows the placeholder 'x.y.z'). Free-form: no semver pattern is asserted because agent products version themselves differently.

process_id.title: Process id
process_id.description: OS process id of the agent session's root process (spec section 19.2, example 18422). Child processes (bash, git, node, cargo) remain attributed to this session via cgroup/lineage where possible (spec section 22).

user.title: Launching user
user.description: Identity of the human who started the agent (spec sections 19, 19.2). Spec example is an email address ('alice@acme.com'); format is not asserted because local-account identities may not be emails.

project.title: Project
project.description: Project the agent session belongs to (spec sections 14, 19.2), e.g. 'atlas'. Drives project-aware policy, networking and workspace access (spec sections 27, 36).

environment.title: Environment
environment.description: Developer environment instance the session runs in (spec sections 17, 19.2), e.g. 'atlas-dev-42'.

status.title: Session status
status.description: Lifecycle status of the session. Spec section 19.2 shows only 'active'; this enum widens additively as lifecycle values are defined — the compatible change this description reserved. Milestone 7 adds 'ended': the registry appends one record per lifecycle transition (active at registration, ended at session end or when a dead process is reaped), so both values appear in /var/lib/punar/agents/registry.jsonl.

classification.title: Registry classification
classification.description: How the registry classifies this agent (spec section 19.1): 'managed' (known, approved, launched through the managed Punar runtime), 'observed' (known AI agent running outside the managed runtime), 'unknown' (potential agentic/AI activity with uncertain identity — covers the spec's UNKNOWN / SUSPECTED class).

started_at.title: Session start time
started_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp when the session started (spec section 19.2, shown there as the placeholder '...').
